day4_after_start.text: *After school. The bell rang. The classroom empties out. Inside my bag, the envelope and the SD card case knock against each other.*

day4_after_start_2.text: *I write down the clues I saw at lunch.*

day4_after_start_3.text: *Sea heads for the student council room. Ms. Eunsu should be in the faculty office, and Nurse Riin in her office.*

day4_after_sea_route.text: *I followed Sea to the student council room.*

day4_after_sea_2.text:
*Sea locks the door. Click. The sound echoes through the empty hallway.*

Do you have to lock it? We can talk with it just closed.

day4_after_sea_3.text: Let’s keep the door closed while we talk today.

day4_after_sea_4.text:
*Sea's eyes are red around the edges. A crumpled tissue lies on the desk.*

Have you been crying? If it's about me, just tell me.

day4_after_sea_5.text:
*Outside the window, students are leaving the sports field. Through the glass, their mouth movements and laughter are out of sync.*

See the students outside? Their mouths and laughter don’t match. Do you notice it too?

day4_after_sea_7.text:
*Sea won't look away.*

I'm right here. Talk to me instead of staring.

day4_after_sea_8.text: How many times has it been?

day4_after_sea_10.text:
How many times what? Don't stop halfway.

*She opens and closes her mouth twice before finally speaking.*

day4_after_sea_force.text:
*'Forget it.' Even after saying it, Sea can't close her lips. Her fingertips touch the knot of her bracelet.*

Stop telling me to forget. I asked because I don't know. I get that you don't want to answer.

day4_after_sea_accept.text: *Whatever I answer, she doesn’t step aside at the door.*

day4_after_sea_accept_3.text:
*Sea looks out the window. The sunset paints the student council room in red.*

I heard you say stay here. What next? Can I leave after sundown?

day4_after_sea_confess_2.text: What? Twelve times? What do you mean? I thought this was my first time here. Don’t talk as if something I can’t remember should be obvious to me.

day4_after_sea_confess_3.text: I put your name tag on this desk twelve times. I heard you say "I'll come tomorrow too" twelve times.

day4_after_sea_confess_4.text: Every morning on the fifth day, you looked past my shoulder.

day4_after_sea_confess_5.text:
*Sea started to rub at her eyes with the end of her sleeve, then stopped.*

So this wasn't your first time meeting me. You made it seem like it was. I thought it was the first.

day4_after_sea_confess_6.text: For the 9th time, you made me a bracelet. With ‘Sea’ engraved on the inside.

day4_after_sea_confess_7.text:
*She rolls up her sleeve. An old string bracelet circles her wrist, frayed in several places.*

I'm not asking you to take it off. Can I look closer? I don't recognize something I made.

day4_after_sea_confess_8.text: The tenth time, you saw this and asked, 'It's pretty, who gave it to you?'

day4_after_sea_confess_9.text: You tied it for me. There wasn’t even a mark on your wrist.

day4_after_sea_confess_10.text:
*Sea smiles with wet eyes.*

You don't have to smile. You remember everything I forgot. Do you have to smile now too?

day4_after_sea_12loop.text:
*Sea grabs my arm tight.*

Wait. I haven't gone anywhere. Talk before grabbing me. I don't know what you're thinking.

day4_after_sea_12loop_2.text: *She murmurs, almost too quietly to hear.*

day4_after_sea_12loop_4.text: Seojin? What did you just call me? You know my name.

day4_after_sea_12loop_6.text:
*Sea’s grip tightens, wrinkling the sleeve of my uniform.*

Let go and answer me. I asked who that was.

day4_after_sea_12loop_7.text: *Seojin. The third name tag I saw on an empty desk.*

day4_after_sea_12loop_9.text:
*She does not let go of my arm. Her fingertips keep creasing my uniform sleeve.*

You won't tell me or let go. At least say what you want me to do. I'm listening.

day4_after_sea_12loop_10.text: *When she rolled up her sleeve, I saw an old string bracelet around her wrist, frayed in several places.*

day4_after_sea_12loop_11.text:
*'Sea' on the handmade bracelet. My handwriting.*

That looks just like my writing. Who carved your name?

day4_after_sea_12loop_12.text:
*Sea notices my gaze on the bracelet.*

I'm trying to see it. Not take it. I know it's my writing, but I don't remember making it.

day4_after_sea_12loop_14.text:
*She's smiling. The moisture under her eyelashes still hasn't dried.*

You don't have to smile. Seeing the bracelet doesn't make me remember at once. But I can see you're crying.

day4_after_ft_sea_pre.text:
*Sea won't release my arm as I try to rise.*

I'm listening. Standing doesn't mean I stop. You don't have to hold me to talk.

day4_after_ft_sea.text: If you have something to say, say it. It won't change anything.

day4_after_ft_sea_choice.text: *What should I say? Sea is still gripping my arm.*
choices: I need to move now. We'll talk later.
What did you remember through all twelve cycles?

day4_after_ft_sea_apologize.text: I've heard that thirteen times. I know you meant it every time.

day4_after_ft_sea_ask.text: I didn't remember. I wrote it down again every time.

day4_after_ft_sea_promise.text: I've heard that too. You said it, then forgot the next day.

day4_after_ft_sea_post.text:
*She lets go. Finger marks remain on my arm. She hides the bracelet's knot beneath her sleeve again.*

You left marks. Holding me won't make me remember more. Hiding the bracelet doesn't unsee it.

day4_after_eunsu_route.text: *I headed for the faculty office. The envelope in my bag taps against my side with every step.*

day4_after_eunsu_2.text:
*Ms. Eunsu sees me and sighs. She still looks tired. She is alone in the faculty office. All the chairs at the other desks are pushed neatly underneath.*

You're alone. We can talk here, right? Please don't avoid this.

day4_after_eunsu_4.text: ...Have you seen what number you are on the attendance register?

day4_after_eunsu_4a.text:
*As she talks, she pours water into the dripper. The stream from the kettle never breaks.*

Does the row number matter more than my name? I came for my records, not just a number.

day4_after_eunsu_5.text:
*Once both cups are full, she places one in front of me.*

You know what I've realized. Let's talk about that, not coffee.

day4_after_eunsu_6.text:
*Two spoonfuls of sugar, half a portion of cream. Exactly what I added yesterday in the faculty office.*

You remember after seeing it once? I never told you.

day4_after_eunsu_7.text: *...I never told her. She only watched me do it once yesterday.*

day4_after_eunsu_8.text: That's right, isn't it? Your preference.

day4_after_eunsu_9.text:
*Ms. Eunsu smiles. The coffee cup’s handle points toward my left hand.*

Even the handle. Is coffee the only thing you've arranged for me?

day4_after_eunsu_10.text: *The desk drawer is half open. I can see Post-it notes inside. Dozens of them. Dense handwriting. -- All names. Different names. Some with lines crossed through them.*

day4_after_eunsu_11.text:
*On the bottom Post-it, my name. No line through it.*

Were those names transfer students too? Why hasn’t mine been crossed out?

day4_after_eunsu_13.text: It's okay, {name}. I'll put it back in order.

day4_after_eunsu_14.text:
*Ms. Eunsu’s hand stops above my head. The fingers that were about to stroke it curl inward.*

Don't touch me. Explain what 'adjust again' means. You're going to do it to me.

day4_after_eunsu_15.text:
*There is red pen ink on those fingertips. The same color as the check marks in the management ledger.*

There's ink on your fingers. That's the pen you wrote with. Don't touch my head.

day4_after_riin_route.text: *I went to the nurse's office. The smell of disinfectant seeps out through the gap beneath the door.*

day4_after_riin_2.text:
*Nurse Riin is sorting papers. When she sees me, her hands stop and she turns the papers over. The movement looks natural, but I have already read the title: “S-13 Medication Records.”*

Don't hide it. That's me, right? Why do you have a dosage record?

day4_after_riin_4.text:
*Her hand stays on the turned-over papers. Part of the title is still visible beneath her palm: `S-13`.*

I can see it. Did you write it? If it's about me, I should be allowed to read it.

day4_after_riin_5b.text: You need to tell me now, don't you? I've brought it up, so don't pretend you didn't hear. I'm here for an answer, not to scare you.

day4_after_riin_6.text:
*Silence. Three seconds. Nurse Riin does not take her eyes off my face.*

I'm waiting. I don't know what you know. That's why I came. Please answer now.

day4_after_riin_7.text: How much have you figured out?

day4_after_riin_8.text:
*Nurse Riin speaks calmly, then gets up, checks the nurse's office door and locks it.*

Why lock it? If I tell you what I saw, will you let me leave?

day4_after_riin_10.text: The basement door and M-13. The vanished names.

day4_after_riin_11.text:
*Nurse Riin doesn’t answer until the thermometer’s indicator goes dark.*

Answer me. I can't go back and pretend I don't know.

day4_after_riin_12.text: ...That was fast. Faster than the twelfth.

day4_after_riin_15.text:
*Nurse Riin takes a key from her pocket. A small metal key.*

A key? For me? Tell me which door now. I might not get back later.

day4_after_riin_16.text:
*Riin stops with the metal key extended.*

Give it to me. Don't pull it back. Don't I need it?

day4_after_riin_18.text:
*The key goes back into her pocket.*

Don't just say not yet. Will waiting change anything?

day4_after_riin_19.text: What is it? You may understand without naming it, but I don't. You have to tell me what's going to happen to me.

day4_after_riin_21.text:
*Nurse Riin looks at me. Her crooked name-tag lanyard doesn’t move.*

Tomorrow's the last day. Can I come in the morning? Who should I go to first?

day4_after_riin_22.text: Don't move tonight. And don't tell anyone about this.

day4_after_riin_25.text: I'll keep them out until tomorrow morning.

day4_after_riin_26.text:
*Riin looks out the window. The setting sun. The nurse's office is bathed in orange light.*

Please look at me, not outside, when you talk. If you stop, I can't get out of here.

day4_after_end.text: *The sun sets, and the lights in the classroom windows go out one by one. Tomorrow is the fifth day.*

day4_xover_yuna_1.text:
*As I was about to leave the classroom -- Yuna was standing in the hallway. Waiting.*

Were you waiting? Is it all right to talk in the corridor? You've come to find me, so I'm wondering if something happened.

day4_xover_yuna_5.text: Every time. Same face walks in. Says they don't know.

day4_xover_yuna_7.text: They're all here. From number one to now.

day4_xover_yuna_9.text:
*I looked at the album. Same uniform. Same hallway. Same face -- only the expressions differ. Twelve photos.*

I don't remember any of this. Just the face is mine. And you still talked to me after seeing it?

day4_xover_yuna_10.text: *Yuna closed the album and walked away in silence.*

day4_xover_yuna_skip.text: *As I leave the classroom -- Yuna is standing in the hallway.*

day4_xover_yuna_skip_met.text: *As I leave the classroom -- Yuna is standing in the hallway.*

day4_xover_yuna_skip_3.text: *Yuna shook her head and walked away.*
